message:
Decide in one place which AI Service methods call the model

The proxy, the validation and the tool error notice each had their own idea
of which methods of an AI Service interface are implemented by calling the
model. The notice even had to know about ChatMemoryAccess.

AiServiceValidation.isImplementedByModel() is now the only place that says
so: static and default methods run as written, Object and ChatMemoryAccess
methods are handled by the proxy itself, everything else calls the model.

- The proxy dispatches everything else to invokeImplementedByProxy().
- Validation no longer checks the return types of getChatMemory() and
  evictChatMemory() as if they were AI Service methods. They passed only
  because dev.langchain4j.memory is not among the packages whose types are
  rejected.
- The notice no longer looks at methods at all. DefaultAiServices tells it
  whether a method returns neither an asynchronous nor a reactive type, and
  the notice asks only when the AI Service has tools.

Tests cover a static method and ChatMemoryAccess in validation, and the
ChatMemoryAccess methods through the proxy without calling the model.
